3166.title: Provider maintenance can update manager-owned executables
3166.rootCauseOneLine: Provider bridges query package registries and choose update actions before they can identify manager-owned executable paths.
3166.proposedFix: Add a shared canonical-path ownership probe and make each provider short-circuit registry lookups and update actions for externally managed executables.
3166.caveats: The exact reporter machine was not accessed; two clean checkouts reproduced an equivalent manager-owned Claude path, while Codex and Pi behavior was verified statically.
